facts.business: AceVector Limited operates a digital commerce ecosystem comprising Snapdeal, a value fashion marketplace, and Unicommerce, a SaaS platform for e-commerce operations and logistics management.
key_risks: Current liabilities exceed current assets by INR 308.94 Mn, requiring financial support from shareholders to meet obligations
Company incurred cash losses of Rs. 612.56 Mn in the current year
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
